name: Aurora Model Tool MCP Edit Interface
description: Mutating MCP tool subset for editing Aurora model homes via validation-gated, transactional operations (no direct file writes). Covers the minimum write capabilities in REQ-028 (create/update/delete cards; create/update/delete links) and enforces confirmation gating by hosting policy (REQ-029), exclusive lock semantics (REQ-025), and validation on write (REQ-017).
